text:
maria: Heads up — change window tonight 02:00–03:00 UTC. Planned work: API v2.3.1 (schema add), runtime kernel opt (kv-cache bump), console migration to new docs endpoint, router header split. Need pins and release notes pushed by 01:30 UTC.
aj: +1. Which services need reserved DEDICATED capacity? runtime + router for spike.
maria: runtime and router pinned for canary. API canary first. deploy-bot, schedule canary waves: 02:00 US->EU at 02:10->APAC at 02:20
deploy-bot: @maria acknowledged. Creating waves: canary(1%), ramp(10% @02:10), ramp(50% @02:20). See /deploy status 6001234567
samir: putting pin request: `/deploy pin runtime 1.9.0-rc2 --scope=canary --until=2026-04-01T06:00Z` please approve
liz: console change needs rollout flag on .env: `NEW_DOCS=true` do not enable until runtime canary passes
aj: rollback criteria: 5xx rate >1% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms OR regression on eval set (prompt set 431). If hit, abort and pin previous variant.
maria: agree. Add automatic fallback to runtime-legacy and router-stable on failure.
console-bot: release notes draft: https://internal/redwood/release-notes/6001234567 — please add bullet for migration and console flag
samir: all set from runtime side. I'll watch canary. @aj you'll handle router pin?
aj: yes, I'll pin router to hd-split-v3 for canary and monitor header-level 200s
deploy-bot: Starting canary wave 02:00 UTC — API v2.3.1 -> runtime 1.9.0-rc2 -> router hd-split-v3 -> console flag off. Posting updates here. :rocket:
maria: thanks. If anything unexpected, call the quiet-window channel and escalate. Keep release notes + customer-impact lines updated by 01:45
samir: noted. standby on pager 02:00-03:30
liz: I'll flip NEW_DOCS to true after canary @03:00 if stable :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary completed at 02:12 UTC. metrics OK (5xx=0.02%, p95 +12ms). ramping to 10%.
maria: great. leaving this thread as canonical for the window.
